title: FermiNet: quantum physics of molecules from first principles
summary: A neural network for electron wavefunctions: for the smallest molecules it captures 99.8% of the correlation energy relative to a Slater determinant, at least 97% for bicyclobutane (30 electrons), and a mean error of 4 meV for excited states of the carbon dimer versus 20 meV for earlier methods. The page is dated 2024-08-22 but gives the original date as 2020-10-19; the method is approximate.
